newsitem.title: USA: Rio plans bid for Detroit casino license.
newsitem.headline: Rio plans bid for Detroit casino license.

text.p: Rio Hotel & Casino Inc, owner and operator of the Rio Hotel in Las Vegas, Thursday entered into an agreement to bid for one of three gambling licenses in Detroit.
In a statement, Rio said it has formed a joint venture with Paradise Valley LLC called Paradise Valley Rio LLC to pursue a license.
Rio joins other major hotel and gambling companies like MGM Grand Inc, Circus Circus Enterprises Inc and Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Inc in announcing plans to seek one of the Detroit licenses.

The move marks Rio's first effort to expand outside Las Vegas, where it recently completed the final phase of its master development for the Rio hotel. Rio owns about 40 acres adjacent to the hotel, and industry observers had expected its next move to be an expansion onto that land.
Preliminary proposals are due August 1. City officials will eventually pick three companies with which to negotiate final contracts.
In November last year, Michigan voters approved a referendum calling for gambling in Detroit in the hope it would revitalize urban areas of the city.
Paradise Valley LLC is owned primarily by residents of Detroit. Its partners include former Mayor Coleman Young.
Details of the proposal were not disclosed.
